verdicts.reason: The repo matches the claim. D-10-2.next is [D-8-4, E-7-1, D-10-1, D-2-2, D-2-3, D-2-4], D-10-3.next is [E-7-1, D-8-4] and D-10-T.next is [E-7-T, F-2-T], so none offers F-6-1 or F-2-3; D-10-1 offers both, and I reproduced this with node from data/visamap.yaml. The F-2-3 decree row puts no condition on the status currently held. Both targets have in-Korea 'change' document lists (visadocs-targets.txt). The same gap for D-8/D-9 was already confirmed 2-0 on the same sources. I could not fetch easylaw or law.go.kr myself (WebFetch fails DNS); the two quotes below come from those earlier verifiers' fetches.

verdicts.reason: Both the D-10-1 -> F-2-R note and visas['F-2-R'].how list '...and 5 years in a depopulating area' among the entry conditions, which reads as past residence. The MOJ notice (거주(F-2) 파목 기준) makes it a forward-looking undertaking counted from the date F-2-R is granted. The 2026 manual's change list in data/visadocs.yaml confirms that actual residence in the recommending area is checked at application, with a special exception for people who could not move there yet. Practitioner summaries add that the first 2 years must be spent in the recommended area, after which a move to another depopulating area in the same province is allowed. The fix is right in substance. I only softened 'must already live', because of the residence exception.
verdicts.correctedFix:
Replace the English text in both places (visas.D-10-1.next[to: F-2-R].note.en and visas['F-2-R'].how.en):
  D-10-1 -> F-2-R note.en: 'Local-government recommendation, a Korean associate degree or regional-wage income, KIIP 3 or TOPIK 3. You must live in the recommending area and commit to living and working (or running a business) in that depopulating area for 5 years after approval: the first 2 years in the recommended area itself, then you may move to another depopulating area in the same province. Not possible if your visa before D-10 was D-3, D-4, E-6-2, E-8, E-9, E-10, G-1 or H-1.'
  F-2-R how.en: 'Local-government recommendation, a Korean associate degree or regional-wage income, KIIP 3 or TOPIK 3, and a commitment to live and work in the recommended depopulating area for 5 years after approval (the first 2 years in the recommended area itself).'
The ru, uz and uz-cyrl strings must be retranslated to match; the current ones carry the same 'and 5 years' wording.

verdicts.reason: The repo matches the claim. D-10-1.next has E-6-1 but not E-6-3, and E-6-3 has no needs, age or countries gate, so adding it filters nobody. The D-10 chapter of the manual names E-6-2 as the only excluded part of E-6 and allows pure arts and sports, and sports means E-6-3. The 2026 manual's E-6 change chapter, as copied into data/visadocs.yaml, has the case 'D-2 / D-10 holder changing to E-6' under E-6-3.change as well as E-6-1.change. So this is a documented in-Korea change to a visa that has a 'change' list.
verdicts.correctedFix:
In data/visamap.yaml visas.D-10-1.next insert a bare entry right after `- E-6-1`:
    - E-6-3

verdicts.reason: The engine claim is true. The D-10-1 -> F-2-7 move and F-2-7 itself have no needs, and the node run shows a 27-year-old with a foreign bachelor's gets 'yes' (open). With {koreanEdu: 4} that reader gets 'no'; a NONE > D-2-3 > D-10-1 reader gets 'yes' through D-2-3's gives; a blank answer stays 'maybe'. Several practitioner sources quote the manual's rule that D-2/D-10 holders qualify for F-2-7 only with a Korean master's (or a pending one) and a confirmed job, so the koreanEdu: 4 gate is right. I could not read the 2026 primary text (WebFetch fails DNS). The fallback `[{koreanEdu: 4}, {edu: 4}]` has no legal basis: a foreign master's opens no D-10 -> F-2-7 track. Keeping the note's 'or a job at a listed company or in a promising industry' would contradict the gate, so the note must change with it. The Korean-War-ally exception (Korean bachelor's plus a ministry recommendation) cannot be expressed without a new country group, so it is left to the note.

verdicts.reason: The current note on D-10-3 -> E-7-1 is 'After 1+ year of internship: education and experience requirements are waived.' It leaves out both conditions the manual attaches to the waiver: formal employment in the internship field, and a wage of at least the previous year's per-capita GNI. The 2022 MOJ press release that created D-10-3 sets the same GNI condition. Meanwhile E-7-1's own text quotes the much lower ₩31.1M floor, so a reader relying on the waiver at that salary would be refused. The fix is a note-only change on an existing edge, so the engine can express it.
verdicts.correctedFix:
In data/visamap.yaml visas.D-10-3.next, set the E-7-1 entry's note.en to:
  'After 1+ year of internship, if you are formally hired in the field of your internship at a salary of at least the previous year''s per-capita GNI, the education and experience requirements are waived.'
The ru, uz and uz-cyrl notes must be retranslated to match.
